name: POZ/BTB and AT hook containing zinc finger 1

function.text: PATZ1 encodes POZ-, AT hook-, and zinc finger-containing protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and ubiquitin protein ligase binding. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Thyroid-like follicular renal cell carcinoma; Round cell sarcoma with EWSR1–non-ETS fusions. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
